cases.name: SemanticNode::semanticData is the back-pointer set at node creation
cases.note: The executable Rust test preserves the pinned owners, listener multiplicity, flags, ids, action order, lookup identity, and individual assertion stream.

adaptation.rationale: Pinned C++ stores a raw SemanticData pointer on SemanticNode; Rust's RuntimeSemanticData-created node retains the owner's stable local identity instead of a potentially dangling owner pointer.
adaptation.inapplicable_observable: Raw C++ SemanticData pointer equality; the live Rust node's semantic_data_local_id is asserted against the creating RuntimeSemanticData owner.

cases.name: requestFocus on a registered node with no coreOwner returns false
cases.note: The executable Rust test preserves the pinned owners, listener multiplicity, flags, ids, action order, lookup identity, and individual assertion stream.

adaptation.rationale: Pinned C++ requestFocus walks coreOwner and sibling FocusData pointers; Rust's owner-safe request_focus exposes the retained SemanticData local identity to a callback and returns false before invoking it when no owner identity exists.
adaptation.inapplicable_observable: Raw C++ coreOwner pointer traversal; the live Rust node has no core_owner_local_id or SemanticData identity and the production manager returns false.

cases.name: requestFocus on a boundary node returns false
cases.note: The executable Rust test preserves the pinned owners, listener multiplicity, flags, ids, action order, lookup identity, and individual assertion stream.

adaptation.rationale: Pinned C++ requestFocus rejects a boundary lacking an associated SemanticData/FocusData owner; Rust's owner-safe request_focus rejects the live boundary node because no SemanticData local identity is retained.
adaptation.inapplicable_observable: Raw C++ boundary coreOwner and sibling-pointer traversal; the production Rust manager returns false for the retained boundary identity.
